   - Customer ID normalization (trim + uppercase)
   - Invoice number generation with yearly counter reset

   - src/invoices.js: Created with createInvoice(), lineTotal(), lineDiscount(), invoiceTotals(), addLine(), removeLine(), issueInvoice(); removed local isValidDate() to import from dates.js
   - src/numbering.js: Created with nextInvoiceNumber() generating INV-YYYY-COUNTER format with 4-digit zero-padded counters that reset yearly
   - src/render.js: Created renderInvoiceText() returning plain text with invoice number/DRAFT, customer name, line items with discount indicators, subtotal/discount/VAT rows, and formatted totals using formatEuros()
   - src/customers.js: Added normalizeId() function and TIER_DISCOUNTS object (gold: 5, silver: 2.5, standard: 0); updated getCustomer() to normalize IDs
   - src/dates.js: Created isValidDate(), addDays(), daysBetween() all using UTC-only date handling
   - src/payments.js: Created recordPayment(invoice, {amount, date}) and balanceDue(invoice); recordPayment creates invoice.payments array if missing, validates amount is positive integer, checks for overpayment, updates status to 'paid'/'partially_paid'
   - test/invoices.test.js: Added tests for discount functionality, tier discounts, VAT calculations with proper test expectations updated to account for VAT amounts
   - test/payments.test.js: Created 16 tests for payment recording and balance tracking
